initial_finding.title: Bind the recorded parent source map to its historical commit

binding_contract.trust_root: Fixed module REPOSITORY_ROOT; no caller-selectable trust callback or production bypass
binding_contract.commit: Recorded 40-hex source_commit must resolve to that exact commit in the fixed local repository
binding_contract.sources: Every validated canonical relative .py path must identify a regular 100644/100755 Git blob at the recorded commit; exact historical bytes SHA256 must match identity.sources
binding_contract.history: Older recorded commits may differ from current HEAD; missing commit, source path, object, type or hash fails closed
binding_contract.git: Local literal pathspecs; sanitized GIT_* environment; replacement objects and lazy fetch disabled; no source execution or network fetch
binding_contract.read_order: Check blob type and batched size admission before requesting bounded batched source bytes
binding_contract.controls: Reject NUL, newline, carriage return, tab, other ASCII control characters and DEL, backslash, colon, parent traversal and noncanonical paths
unchanged_gates: Exact base and zero-LoRA parent stage
Positive matching optimizer steps and terminal evaluation metadata
Registered runtime and explicit human review fields
Explicit model-load/training permission and per-arm native mechanics gates

static_review.independent_verdict: No actionable findings in the three-file diff. Exact commit resolution, regular-blob SHA256 binding, fixed repository root, fail-closed limits, and older-commit eligibility are consistent.
static_review.method: Ordinary source and Git metadata inspection only

fixture_validation.evidence_scope: Software metadata contract checks using independent tiny Git source repositories and opaque non-model adapter fixtures only

limitations: The fix checks exact historical source-byte binding; it does not prove the training receipt or human-review attestations truthful.
Fixture success does not establish actual SFT parent eligibility, model capability, native resource fit, containment or ML runtime parity.
Initial P2 record is preserved as historical review evidence; this separate create-only record documents its code resolution.
Commit and push are reserved to Root; this reviewer made no publication action.
